page.layout: One page of text, single column, with no margin notes. Running head top left, page number top right. Continuation of a letter, then the closing date line, then the heading "EPIST. XV.", the argument of the letter, the greeting and the opening paragraph. Catchword and gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.p: gregationis jussu, jam sunt efformati; & tunc curabo diligenter, ut illis quam primum perfruaris. Cæterum te R. Pater etiam atque etiam rogo, ut me, sicut facis diligas, meque tibi devinctissimum, ac tui semper observantissimum fore pro certo habeas.
Vale Romæ. Duodecimo Kalend. Aprilis [?], Anno Domini MDCXXX.
main_text.head: EPIST. XV.
Joh. Morinus Petro à Valle Exemplaris M. S. versionis Samaritanæ, quod erat Petri à Valle judiciis à viro de Samaritanorum Judæorumque Codicibus Annotata.

p.i: Nobilissimo & perillustri viro Petro à Valle, Joannes Morinus S. D.

main_text.p: NUdiusfertius literas tuas accepi, quæ multis nominibus mihi fuerunt gratissimæ. Plurima enim, quæ à te rescire exoptabam, mihi aperuerunt, in nonnullis etiam desiderium meum humanitas tua prævenit. Sed eo præsertim nomine

page.notes: The first word of the page, "gregationis", is a fragment carried over from the previous page and is kept as such. The date "CIↃ IↃ CXXX" is read as MDCXXX. The month word "Aprilis" is doubtful in the scan (it looks like "Aprils") and is marked [?]. The final word "nomine" is split at the line end by a printed hyphen; the continuation "mine" at the foot is the catchword. The right side of the scan (grey streaks and show-through) is not printed text and is left out.
